classes.SOURCE: Raw downloads/scrapes: expensive or impossible to recreate. Never a delete candidate.
classes.RELEASED: Published as a GitHub release asset or datasets branch; restorable by download.
classes.REBUILDABLE: Recreated from SOURCE/RELEASED inputs by a recorded command.
classes.DUPLICATE: Same bytes (or a superset) exist at another recorded location.
classes.BACKUP: Historical checkpoint kept for comparison; nothing reads it.
classes.OBSOLETE: Superseded or abandoned output; nothing reads it.
